event_var.var_meaning: recurrence indicator for progression-free survival; '0' appears to denote no recurrence (censored), '1' denotes recurrence (event); 'Not available' indicates missing follow-up information

notes: Time and event fields extracted from GEO sample metadata 'characteristics_ch1' (examples: GSM5050316 etc.).
Unit 'days' inferred from the variable name suffix '_days' in the sample metadata.

The paper (PMC8391231) defines 'no recurrence' and recurrence relative to the end of first-line platinum-based chemotherapy; PFS in the dataset appears to be measured relative to that clinical timeline.
Some samples have 'Not available' for the event and/or time (paper notes 3 patients lost to follow-up), indicating missing PFS data.
PMC10137910 refers to 'Disease-free survival (DFS)' in analysis of the same cohort; that term appears to correspond to the 'progression-free-survival_days' variable in GEO.

event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status at last follow-up; 'live' = alive (censored), 'dead' = death (event)

notes: Overall survival time and status are provided in GEO sample metadata 'characteristics_ch1'.
Paper (PMC8391231) reports mean and median follow-up and compares OS between cohorts; OS times in GEO match those reported.
Some samples show identical values for progression-free-survival_days and overall-survival_days when no recurrence/event occurred (consistent with censoring).
